## Site purpose

Independent review and conversion guide for the Pixmove instant game **Falling Pickaxe**. Not affiliated with Pixmove Games. Does not operate gambling services.

## Game summary

Falling Pickaxe (Pixmove, June 2026) is an instant/mining game:

- Player sets a bet and drops one pickaxe into a vertical block shaft
- Each strike consumes durability (heart counter on HUD)
- Copper, gold, diamond, emerald blocks pay when cracked
- TNT blasts blocks to open deeper paths
- Upgrade arrow enlarges the pickaxe mid-fall
- Workbench forges a stronger pickaxe tier
- One round can upgrade from wooden to diamond tier if the fall aligns
- Studio-listed RTP: 95%
- Volatility: Low
- Maximum win: ×160 stake
- Bonus Buy available when the operator enables it
- Mobile-first pixel mine HUD

Source: https://pixmove.com/games/falling_pickaxe
